coverage.title: Pixels
coverage.rationale: Keep deterministic frame generation; article anecdotes do not prove model capability.

coverage.title: Setup
coverage.rationale: Use existing dependency checks and approved tools; source installation commands and model settings are examples.

coverage.title: One-liner
coverage.rationale: A showreel one-liner tests the setup; select distinct patterns for a real brief to avoid repeated generic output.

coverage.title: Brand
coverage.rationale: Real assets and claims; genre, 120 BPM and format defaults yield to brief.

coverage.title: Reference
coverage.rationale: Inspect references and extract grammar; preserve explicit approval gates and media gaps.

coverage.title: Spec
coverage.rationale: State lists and one-container morphs apply to selected UI branches, not every film.

coverage.title: Engine
coverage.rationale: Use existing render helpers. Source snippet omits full scene coverage and does not verify encoder exit status.

coverage.title: Springs
coverage.rationale: Closed-form retargeting; source approximation for overdamped springs and modulo alone are not runtime or seam proof.

coverage.title: Sound
coverage.rationale: Measure supplied track; every fourth detected beat does not establish a downbeat; original score only when open.

coverage.title: Overnight
coverage.rationale: Budgeted checkpoints and permitted tools. Silence after ten minutes is not approval; no automatic API upload or delegation.

coverage.title: Critique
coverage.rationale: Inspect phone-size stills, transitions and joins; finite failed-layer repairs. Scores and MP4 hashes do not prove frame correctness.

coverage.title: Ship
coverage.rationale: Recompose requested formats from one timeline; service pricing and promotional performance remain anecdotes.

embedded_media: Embedded post URLs preserved in article; clips and linked repositories not acquired or executed.
